legacyDiagnosis.finding: Native video packets are CFR. Legacy rVFC observation loses presentation callbacks; MediaRecorder creates a different non-CFR clock and playback rVFC selection skips a decoded frame again. Startup/seek and main-thread observation are implicated; the experiment does not isolate all browser scheduling causes.
